verdictReason: Phase 10 requirements certified end-to-end. Single source-of-truth knowledge derivation established across projects, products, gems, status, and config. Releases.ts dynamic derivation eliminated hardcoded version drift. Canonical knowledge registry and deterministic 16-hex knowledge versioning implemented and wired into Worker health/diagnostics (be8d05ff146c8c98 deployed and locally matching). Automated drift detector with 8 integrity checks and Public Knowledge Coverage Matrix integrated into npm run validate. 12 mutation/drift tests proven with vitest (678/678 passed across 41 files). Golden query suite expanded from 249 to 277 queries with 100.0% accuracy across all tiers (Tier 1: 103/103 100%, Tier 2: 141/141 100%, Tier 3: 33/33 100%). Zero provider calls on golden corpus (86.3% avoided overall). Worker deployed to production (version 76581247-3403-43e7-a83c-15a8c40c4d1d) and live verified. Zero paid dependencies added.

driftElimination.releasesHardcoding: Replaced hardcoded CodeForge v0.2.0 and download URL in src/data/kayla/releases.ts with dynamic derivation from src/data/products.ts
driftElimination.ambiguousAliases: Added ambiguous alias resolution to entities.ts disambiguating kayla between kayla-copilot and kayla-ai-publisher using query keywords, page context, and history
driftElimination.retrievalCoverage: Dynamic project doc generation in retrieval.ts ensures every project in projects.ts has a KNOWLEDGE_BASE document
driftElimination.semanticRelations: CanonicalRelations and deniedRelations validated against CANONICAL_ENTITIES with zero collision tolerance
driftElimination.forgedAlignment: Forged storefront items, products with download URLs, and downloadableNow() matrix strictly validated
